# Version 4.152.1
> **Glyph data correction** · Released September 9, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.1) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.1/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.201/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.1 fixes an upstream Skia glyph-data issue in the bundled renderer. This servicing release incorporates the Chrome M152 glyph-data correction without changing the managed API surface.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Chrome M152 glyph-data fix merged** — Updates the bundled Skia engine with the upstream glyph-data correction, improving text rendering behavior for affected fonts and glyphs. ([#5047](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5047))
